description: Archive (soft-delete) a schedule. It stops appearing in the active list and no further reminders go out for it, but past reminder history is preserved. This is reversible only from the dashboard. Confirm with the user before archiving. Requires the `schedules:write` scope.

schedule_id.description: The schedule's numeric id (from list_schedules or get_schedule).

name: archive_schedule
title: Archive a schedule
